      ELSE 0

  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY u.id, acquisition_month, u.created_at
)
SELECT 
  TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  SUM(placed_order_in_30days) AS users_with_order,
  ROUND((SUM(placed_order_in_30days)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_cohorts
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC
